text: A vendor's bank details change by email, days before a big payment run. Policy says call back on a number that did not come from the letter, but finding that number takes four systems. This is Probity's inbox: every bank-change request waiting before Friday's payments.
Booz Allen Hamilton asks to move its remit address and bank account. Three payments, one point two eight million dollars, are due Friday.
Here is the letter. Nemotron Ultra reads it into quoted claims, so every claim points back to a line on the page.

And here is the decision: hold. The new address belongs to a different Booz Allen company, not our vendor. The bank account is already on another vendor. And the sender's domain imitates the real one. Code decides the verdict, with a reason code for each block.
Each fact opens an evidence drawer: the exact Zetaris query, the rows it returned, and the lineage back to USAspending or SEC EDGAR. I can re-run that query in Zetaris, live, from right here.
Same rows, same hash. The evidence holds.
note: rerun result (played when the result appears)

text: The World Model keeps what the request claims, what our records say, and what the registries say, as one graph. The decision path shows how the requested account leads to another vendor, and the conflicts are marked.

Probity never trusts the number on the letter. The call-back is seven oh three, nine oh two, five-zero-zero-zero, from SEC EDGAR filings. The two numbers on the request are marked do not use, and a call script is ready.

Then, unasked, it checks the rest of Friday's payment run. Two more payments, about a hundred and fifty thousand dollars, fail payment controls, found by Zetaris data-quality rules across all payment items.
Everything exports as a dossier: the decision, the reasons, the evidence and the queries behind them, ready for an auditor.

Why trust it? Registry facts come from Zetaris queries you can re-run. The readings come from Nemotron models through Nightshift, and every model call has a receipt naming the model. The World Model carries memory between sessions. And a fact that cannot be read shows as unknown, never as fine.

text: And when a change is genuine, Probity says so. For L3Harris it approves, with the call-back number from SEC EDGAR on record.
Probity: verify the bank change before the money moves. Grok built the Zetaris data layer and the independent test suite. Claude Code built the agents and the interface.
